dims_mm.hub_offsets: core offset 8 mm on one side and 12 mm on the other; 4 mm centre web (product page text + schematic)
dims_mm.hole_patterns: 8x thru-holes on 16 mm pattern and 8x outer thru-holes on 32 mm pattern, Ø4 mm (goBILDA standard patterns)
dims_mm.rollers: 16 rollers in two offset rows of 8 (CAD)

colors.hub_and_sideplates: matte black plastic (photo median ~rgb(54,52,50); CAD uses rgb(60,60,60))
colors.roller_pins: steel, silver (CAD rgb(217,217,217)) - visible as small silver dots at roller ends
colors.screws: 8 black Phillips rounded-head screws on the outer sideplate face
colors.print: pad-printed yellow-gold ring arc plus text 'Ø96mm - 50A' and 'goBILDA.com' on the outer sideplate face; sampled ~#FAD32E (rgb 250,211,46) from the official product image. NOT in the CAD: must be added as a decal/texture.

notes: Exact part matches the team render (black hub, gold ring, 'goBILDA.com · Ø96mm · 50A'). The part number is 3624 series (omni wheel), not 3606 (3606 is the mecanum set). The STEP is the official goBILDA download, 2024-05-17. The printed yellow ring and text are a surface print, not geometry. The small goBILDA logos in two of the hub triangles appear in the CAD-derived spec-sheet line drawings, so they are probably modelled (not checked face by face). The product image is a CG render on goBILDA's site, so the sampled colours are approximate.
